validation.deadline: Stalled requests release the server slot without generation replay. Advancing the UI clock past 200 seconds ends loading with MUSE_WAIT_LIMIT, retains the full prompt, and records one request only.
validation.batched_chat: Six prompts in one native user message. Six out-of-order videos in one assistant response are attributed by short CLIP labels without UUID filenames. A task-specific explicit capacity rejection retries only that task.
validation.old_history: Re-rendered historical media nodes and late media tagged to another cohort are excluded from both attribution and fresh media counters.
validation.download_retry: Temporary 404 file readiness is retried as a download only, inside the deadline, without a second generation message.
validation.packaged_executable: Standalone EXE startup; ten overlapping images despite deliberately failing loopback global fetch; exact names and numbered directory exports persist after restart; ten named shared-chat videos with six concurrent tasks; explicit capacity rejection completes remaining scenes serially; account-session media recovery rerun on packaged EXE.
validation.preserved_features: TXT/SRT names and full prompts; account choices and individual proxies/IP; image-to-video; session persistence; cancellation and renderer recovery.
validation.limitation: Generation checks use a fixture service and no real Muse credits. One-message batching is verified locally and on Windows but not on the user's live account. The 200-second cap ends waiting; it cannot guarantee remote completion within that time.
